source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
As your [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) begins, you may pick 1 of these to apply until your next [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) begins:

- **Eliminate At All Costs**: pick 1 enemy unit anywhere on the battlefield; attacks by your **AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM** models that target it get +1 to **Hit rolls**.
- **Acquire At All Costs**: pick 1 objective marker anywhere on the battlefield; while an **AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM** unit of yours is in range of it, improve its models' Leadership and Objective Control by 1, and they gain a 5+ invulnerable save.
